structuredContent.body:
## Why this change is needed

The original `scale_capacity_v1` population fixes the main dirty budget at 200. Earlier 100k runs reached the registered five-hour limit before completing every mutation checkpoint. Their failures, budgets, source identities and raw records remain unchanged. This PR registers a separate configuration for measuring the complete incremental workload with a larger dirty budget.

## What changes

Register `scale_wide_dirty_v1` with main dirty budget 4096 and resume limit 1024. Preserve the original 200/1024 profile and product defaults, the continuous mutation history, all no-op/body/API/config/batch stages, full-control builds and all 15 parity tables. The independent fanout population continues to use 8/128 and must actually demonstrate incomplete work followed by closure.

Both configurations retain the same physical streaming oracle contract. Results keep separate profile, source, binary, seed and shard identities; aggregation rejects mixed or missing populations. The independent workflow retains the original five scales, 30 repetitions per scale, 150 shards / 1500 samples, seed 12648430, and measurement capacity/time boundaries. It uses label `p8-scale-wide-dirty-run` and separate artifact names.

Also apply the nine formatting changes reported by the original PR193 check to four inherited source/test files. The failed check and running G8 study remain attached to their original source.

## Validation and current boundary

The original 39 Python protocol tests are unchanged. All 44 tests, including five new profile/aggregate controls, passed on these exact driver/test bytes. Independent source review verifies the actual product and validation inventories and preserves all earlier reviews. These are source and protocol results; native execution and scale performance remain pending.

Before a fresh release producer is built, the new workflow runs `cargo fmt --all -- --check` and the original `cc-eval` `p8_scale` integration target in a separate target directory. This PR remains a draft while its actual engineering checks and measurements are reviewed.

No original TODO is marked complete by this PR. A complete population can support its declared 4096 configuration; it cannot repair or replace the registered 200 population, establish a causal speedup, or justify a stable p99 claim.

## Source and study identities

This PR uses frozen base `base/p8-G8-wide-bfcc-20261009` at `4fe927488d5cb7f26bd27c7624745fb1b6ca202b`, the original G8 source from PR193. This keeps the new study independently testable while PR193 receives its own engineering fixes. Final integration with main will use the actual accepted source and resolve its source bindings explicitly. Exact product/review/guard commits and the actual new run are recorded below after publication.

- Product: `04e77a0f401419aa2192051b3992498a56c4ea01` (tree `ff5315a01fca3d2e003df999503069920ae44d6a`).
- Independent source review: `4b1c0a7f0b682a5e0d34d9fab6eb1e8955f03386`, adding only the canonical review and original source proof.
- Bound study source: `a9448ecadd713b061823ecb96578791f800c0ae7` (tree `1dd376d2d6311ed0ecebafcbb562bbfe03783c0c`), adding only the two current source-binding files.
- Product inventory: 1095 files; 75 differences against the original BASE; 143 validation inputs.
- The original source-only review at `8ef97e53c5ce5d9fb6d89346b1d94ef946710fe1` and all earlier reviews remain in history.
- The original G8/200 run remains [37962416564, attempt 1](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37962416564), source `4fe927488d5cb7f26bd27c7624745fb1b6ca202b`. It is independent of the forthcoming wide run.
